r0.why: Ecosystem of reef-building corals [1]; animals in Cnidaria with anemones and jellyfish [4]; polyp colonies held by calcium carbonate [2]; carbonate exoskeleton unlike anemones [5]; stony corals [3].

r1.why: Rainforests of the sea [8]; <0.1%, half of France [9]; at least 25% of marine species incl. listed groups [10]; few nutrients [11]; warm shallow clear sunny [6]; tropical, smaller deep/cold reefs [12].

r2.why: First appeared 485 Mya, Early Ordovician [7]; most under 10,000 years [18]; formed after Last Glacial Period as sea flooded shelves [17]; grew upward [19]; slow ones drowned without light [20].

r3.why: Darwin's atoll theory from Beagle voyage [24], three stages [26]; fringing reef around subsiding volcanic island [27]; barrier reef with lagoon on dead coral [34,28]; circular atoll [35]; volcano under lagoon, research supported [29,30].

r4.why: 50% decline since 1950, partly due to sensitivity [13]; nitrogen/phosphorus, ocean heat and acidification, overfishing, sunscreen, land-use runoff [14].

r5.why: Tourism, fisheries, shoreline protection [15]; US$30-375 billion (1997/2003) to US$9.9 trillion (2014) [16].
